name: @kickside/identity-ui
title: KickSide Linked Accounts
description: Linked-accounts web component for kickside/identity: generate a link code, list and unlink external accounts.

wippy.description: Renders the Linked accounts modal (custom element kickside-identity-links), opened from the profile dropdown: it generates a short-lived link code the user sends to a bot in a direct message as 'link <code>' to prove ownership of an external chat account (e.g. Discord), lists the accounts already linked to the current user, and lets them unlink one. A starting-agent selector (defaulting to the greeter agent) picks which agent handles the linked account's DMs. It takes no props — the props schema is empty — and talks to the kickside/identity API (/api/v1/identity/*) through the Wippy host's authenticated client (the @wippy-fe/proxy api). The element owns its own modal chrome and emits a 'close' event (X button, mask click, or Escape) that the host must handle to dismiss it.
